A leaked memo

In 2021, an internal memo warned Amazon could run out of U.S. warehouse workers by 2024.

Warehouse attrition reported in the memo

  • 2019
    123%
  • 2020
    159%

Dashed line = 100%, as many exits in a year as the whole workforce.

The memo leaked to Recode in June 2022. Amazon disputed it, and has since raised pay and invested heavily in automation. Treat it as a snapshot of 2021, not today.

Sources: Engadget (opens in a new tab), Fortune (opens in a new tab)

Why it matters

Even with higher pay and more automation, many associates say the work is physically exhausting.

→+

That makes attrition a business problem as well as an HR one. It affects how fast Amazon ships and what shipping costs.
